RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adults 21 years or older may lawfully possess and use cannabis in Maryland.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Maryland?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: Effective July 1, 2023, a person 21 years or older may lawfully possess and use cannabis.

RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_quote: Cannabis products may be purchased from licensed dispensaries.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for adults to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Maryland?
RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_section: Cannabis products may be purchased from licensed dispensaries.

RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_quote: Adults 21 years or older may cultivate up to two cannabis plants at home, with a household cap of two plants.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for adults to grow cannabis in the state of Maryland?
RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_section: A person 21 years or older may lawfully cultivate up to two plants in their home, out of public view. Likewise, a household may cultivate a maximum of two plants, regardless of how many persons over age 21 live in the residence.

RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_quote: Smoking cannabis is prohibited in parks, streets, sidewalks, and other public places.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.question: Is it legal to consume cannabis in parks, on sidewalks, or similar outdoor public spaces in the state of Maryland?
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_section: Smoking cannabis (and hemp) is prohibited in any public place. This includes outdoor spaces and indoor spaces open to the public including parks, streets and sidewalks, bars and restaurants, public transportation (e.g, buses, vans, trains, taxicabs, limousines) and indoor places of employment.

RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_quote: Smoking cannabis is prohibited in bars, restaurants, and other indoor spaces open to the public.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.question: Is it legal for public businesses such as cafes, bars, or conference centers to allow on-site cannabis consumption in the state of Maryland?
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_section: Smoking cannabis (and hemp) is prohibited in any public place. This includes outdoor spaces and indoor spaces open to the public including parks, streets and sidewalks, bars and restaurants, public transportation (e.g, buses, vans, trains, taxicabs, limousines) and indoor places of employment.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: Registered medical cannabis patients may possess medical cannabis.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/Pages/Patient-FAQ's_2.aspx.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Maryland?
MEDICAL.gov_section: Patients do not have to disclose that they possess medical cannabis and do not have to consent to a search.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: A Maryland patient can only obtain legal medical cannabis from a Maryland-licensed dispensary.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/patients_faq.aspx.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Maryland?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: A Maryland patient can only obtain legal medical cannabis from a Maryland-licensed dispensary.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: Registered medical patients may cultivate two additional plants, for a household total of four.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://cannabis.maryland.gov/pages/cannabisfaq.aspx.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Maryland?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: In addition, medical patients registered with the Maryland Cannabis Administration can cultivate two additional plants, for a total of four plants; not to exceed more than four plants in a given residence.
